test_title: PYST 20: SSC CGL - English (Held On : 21 April 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

I do not / like to read / these kind / of novels.
solution:
The correct answer is **'these kind'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The erroneous part of the given sentence is "**these kind."**
 
• **"kind of novels" **is a singular phrase. 
 
• **"These" **is used with plural nouns and hence, it cannot be used before "**kind of novels". **
 
• Hence, **option 1 **is the correct answer. 
 
• To make the sentence correct we need to use **this.**

***Correct sentence - ****I do not / like to read / **this kind** / of novels.*
